iti15:1.1: (Ek. II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti15:2.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaṃyojanam-pi samanupassāmi yeneva saṃyojanena saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsaranti yathayidaṃ bhikkhave taṇhā saṃyojanaṃ. taṇhāsaṃyojanena hi bhikkhave saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsarantīti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati.
iti15:3.1: Taṇhādutiyo puriso dīgham-addhānaṃ saṃsaraṃ | itthabhāvaññathābhāvaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattati ||
iti15:4.1: Evam-ādīnavaṃ ñatvā taṇhādukkhassa sambhavaṃ | vītataṇho anādāno sato bhikkhu paribbaje ti ||
iti15:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||5||
